payload.entry: Pinned Artifacts TUI consumers to an explicit ArtifactsDescriptorSnapshot. App init still discovers once and stores an immutable per-app snapshot; bindings, ArtifactsView, help, catalogs, navigation, quickstart, onboarding, clipboard, and availability read that snapshot. Catalog entries keep artifacts.<pane-id> identity and execute show_artifacts_pane by pane_id (digit is display-only); missing panes notify unavailable. AcePage/visual fast startup patch discover_artifacts_snapshot on artifact_tabs instead of five consumer resolvers. Tests cover cache isolation, two-app isolation, catalog pane_id vs digit, missing-pane notify, bootstrap/completed-zero/failed status, and AcePage fixture reduction. sase bead epic-symbols sase-1t3.7.1.1 is empty. Focused pytest of snapshot, help, catalog, copy, onboarding, and availability passed; just check is next via prepared completion.

payload.entry: Phase work implemented; just check running as 4e3f310c000a5e9f5575e1aecb954a28 (selector escalated to full lane on environmental extension bucket). BOOTSTRAP: _state_init_late now builds bootstrap_artifacts_snapshot(gen 0, no project walk/token read/cache write) + publication state. DEFERRED DISCOVERY: new ArtifactsPublicationMixin (_artifacts_publication.py) scheduled once from _start_post_first_paint_services via thin sync callback; pump-free task runs worker body off-pump, one in-flight + one coalesced pending, rejects superseded epochs and post-teardown results; teardwon flag set in on_unmount. PUBLICATION: stage missing panes on UI thread (propagate keymap/scope/split/description), await mount, re-check generation/lifetime/scope/navigation, then synchronous commit (snapshot, view maps, tab strip, switcher, digit bindings rebuilt via keymap_registry.app, selection preserved by stable pane id with fallback to stitches + correct hooks, dead-pane removal by widget id, pending provider target applied or unavailable notice, help/palette refreshed preserving filter/selection, trace event artifacts.provider_publication). NAV: digits resolve only against committed generation and never replay; explicit provider id while pending retained once (cleared by later in-artifacts nav, scope change; tab switch away drops silently). VIEW: pending shown as dim ellipsis in existing Artifacts header spacer; degraded warning unchanged. TESTS: 15 new tests in tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_post_paint_publication.py (real startup scheduling path, gated worker): bootstrap/discovery-free construction, render/catalog builders, first-paint-then-coherent-publication, hidden-agents startup, pending jump apply/supersede, dead digit, zero providers, retry-after-failure, removal fallback, teardown discard, open help refresh, cold identity, files flag x2. MEASUREMENTS (5 separate-process runs, PYTHONPATH=src, sha ab352aeeb consistent): import 1.73-1.85s, construction 0.76-0.80s with ZERO sync provider calls all runs, deferred worker 0.57-0.60s, cold identity 0.63-0.68s, warm <0.001s. Construction lost the ~0.6s discovery cost vs plan baseline; cold identity stays material and independent (follow-up, not expanded here). Fast-startup harness updated to pin bootstrap to fixture + suppress deferred discovery.

Fixed E402 in src/sase/ace/testing/_startup.py (moved ArtifactsPublicationMixin import to top); ruff check src/ tests/ clean, 15/15 tests/ace/tui/test_artifacts_post_paint_publication.py pass. Phase verified: bootstrap snapshot with zero sync provider calls, deferred post-first-paint publication, 5-run startup measurements in bead note; no epic-symbol leftovers.

payload.entry: FOLLOW-UP TRIAGE (landing audit at 7c68d1860c): Read both children and all 10 child notes. No new task; closed sase-182 is not a duplicate because it fixed tool project identity, not missing repo coverage. Also triaged the informal cold-identity follow-up in sase-1t3.7.1.2 note #1: decline a new optimization task for now. The reported 0.63-0.68s cold / <0.001s warm cost is a pre-existing shared inventory cost, with no demonstrated budget violation or actionable independent regression after first-paint deferral. Preserve those observations; completing the already-required matched startup/visible-readiness measurements remains this epic work. Neither sase-1t3.7.1 nor parent phase sase-1t3.7 has epic-symbol entries at this audit.

LANDING INTERRUPTED at 7c68d1860c: reviewed epic scope/linked plan, both closed children, all 10 child notes, commits 1bd855256e and 7c68d1860c, and actual snapshot/publication/binding/help/catalog/navigation/clipboard source. Existing focused suites pass: 25 tests in 67.40s. Five independent deterministic method probes expose remaining epic work: same-ID healthy-to-degraded change stages 0/retires 0 widgets; second mount failure returns false but leaves first widget mounted; cache epoch 0 result commits after epoch advances to 1; empty-pane mark calls provider_source_token synchronously despite app snapshot; provider added to an already-open palette cannot execute because dismissal captured the old catalog map. Source also lacks normal refresh wiring, robust post-await scope/display reapplication, and tab-away-and-back pending-intent invalidation. Existing help/palette test never opens a palette, and identity coverage can pass without a real cold Agents load. Required matched five-run before/after first-paint, visible-ready, publication, and Agents provider evidence plus targeted visuals are not in phase notes. These are epic acceptance gaps, not standalone follow-ups. No code altered in this landing audit. A bounded medium tale sase_plan_finish_provider_tab_publication.md plans the repairs and same-turn closure, with no dependence on its future commit or CI. Parent phase sase-1t3.7 remains open; outer sase-1t3 belongs to its waiting land agent. No force close attempted. Both epic-symbol inventories are empty. Origin fetched and equals HEAD: ab352aeeb6, a2c9c3ecb5, and 3a2b26855d are the three non-epic commits since the first epic commit; no conflicting provider interfaces found. Broader since-creation drift includes agent-loader memoization and hijack-overlay fixes already retained. Linked core commit a2abeb1e was read through sase_repo: schema-4 corpus compatibility plus lint/test fixture cleanup, already pinned. No memory edits or reinstall; final inherited decisions remain intact. Follow-up triage outcomes are in the preceding note and must be included at close.

Repaired remaining publication/snapshot defects from the landing audit at 7c68d1860c and closed this nested child after verification. Five audit failures now have production fixes plus focused regression tests: same-ID healthy-to-degraded replacement diffs widget signatures (excluding digit/order/presentation_digest) instead of ID membership; replacements mount with id=None, stamp _artifacts_published_pane_id, and promote only at commit after the old widget is removed; partial-mount exceptions discard staged widgets, record _artifacts_last_discovery_error, and retain the prior generation; source epoch is captured at worker end and rechecked before snapshot, on the unchanged fast path, and after awaits; empty-pane mark/copy/refresh helpers take the committed snapshot instead of calling provider_source_token on the UI thread; palette dismiss resolves the selected stable ID against the current committed catalog. Additional source repairs: explicit refresh and background source invalidation schedule rediscovery; ticks revalidate cached token+epoch only; display_name/scope reapplied after awaits; pending provider intent cleared on tab change and later navigation; bindings built before mutating the snapshot.
